patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch from the link below Extract the contents of the patch archive into the game install folder mentioned above, overwriting 'Game.ini' if prompted Patch installed, good to go! It's working if: In Daisy the Dark Elfs pleasure scene, once she is naked (or when she is clothed but you're interacting with her crotch), no flowers on nipples or bunnies on crotches will appear if the patch is working. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
